dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, why didn't you come to the mall with us yesterday?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwaɪ ˈdɪdənt juː ˈkʌm tə ðə ˈmɔːl wɪð ʌs ˈjɛstərdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I don't go to the mall much now. I love online shopping.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈmɔːl ˈmʌtʃ ˈnaʊ. aɪ ˈlʌv ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈʃɑːpɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I put things in my cart, pay, and have them delivered the next day.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈpʊt ˈθɪŋz ɪn maɪ ˈkɑːrt, ˈpeɪ, ənd ˈhæv ðɛm dɪˈlɪvərd ðə ˈnɛkst ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But you can't try on clothes online!
dialogue.reading: bʌt juː ˈkænt ˈtraɪ ɑːn ˈkloʊðz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: True. If they don't fit, I have them picked up by a courier and get a refund.
dialogue.reading: ˈtruː. ɪf ðeɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈfɪt, aɪ ˈhæv ðɛm ˈpɪkt ˈʌp baɪ ə ˈkʊriər ənd ˈɡɛt ə ˈriːfʌnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Usually. And I can track my package on the app, so I know when it will arrive.
dialogue.reading: ˈjuːʒuəli. ənd aɪ kən ˈtræk maɪ ˈpækɪdʒ ɑːn ði ˈæp, soʊ aɪ ˈnoʊ wɛn ɪt wɪl əˈraɪv.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I don't trust couriers. Last month, one left my package on the doorstep, and someone stole it!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈtrʌst ˈkʊriərz. ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, ˈwʌn ˈlɛft maɪ ˈpækɪdʒ ɑːn ðə ˈdɔːrstɛp, ənd ˈsʌmwʌn ˈstoʊl ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! That's why I always have my packages delivered to the front desk of my building.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ðæts ˈwaɪ aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈhæv maɪ ˈpækɪdʒɪz dɪˈlɪvərd tə ðə ˌfrʌnt ˈdɛsk əv maɪ ˈbɪldɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Smart. By the way, did you get your phone fixed?
dialogue.reading: ˈsmɑːrt. baɪ ðə ˈweɪ, dɪd juː ˈɡɛt jʊr ˈfoʊn ˈfɪkst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I had it fixed at a little shop near my building. It looks new!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ hæd ɪt ˈfɪkst ət ə ˈlɪtəl ˈʃɑːp ˈnɪr maɪ ˈbɪldɪŋ. ɪt ˈlʊks ˈnuː!
